name: Vandenberg SLC-4E
tagline: Polar / sun-synchronous gateway — Falcon 9 to Starlink + national-security + earth-observation
description: The US west-coast orbital gateway. Built for Atlas-Agena in 1963; Titan III/IV through to 2005; refit by SpaceX in 2011. Vandenberg's geographic advantage is the corridor due south over the Pacific — that's how US payloads reach polar and sun-synchronous orbits without overflying populated land. Today SLC-4E flies Falcon 9 to Starlink polar shells, NRO classified payloads, USSF + commercial earth-observation satellites. SLC-4W next door is the booster recovery zone.
